title: A Nemzeti Összetartozás Napja (Day of National Unity)
grammar: Causal-Consequence Discourse, Treaty Formulations & Transnational Identity Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Day of National Unity is and when it is held.
I can say why pupils visit schools beyond the border, using azért, hogy.
I can use the words for national unity, reconciliation and cultural unity.
I can read a short account of the Day of National Unity and answer questions about it.
